program = '''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    # The field color is most common; the second common color forms the grid lines.
    field = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    line_color = next((v for v, n in counts.most_common() if v != field), field)
    row_lines = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if sum(v == line_color for v in row) >= 0.65*w]
    col_lines = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == line_color for r in range(h)) >= 0.65*h]
    if len(row_lines) < 2 or len(col_lines) < 2:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    # Adjacent grid-line intersections bound one output cell.
    nr, nc = len(row_lines)-1, len(col_lines)-1
    out = [[field for _ in range(nc)] for _ in range(nr)]
    marked = []
    for i in range(nr):
        for j in range(nc):
            corners = [grid[row_lines[i]][col_lines[j]], grid[row_lines[i]][col_lines[j+1]],

                marked.append((i,j))
    if marked:
        out = [row[:max(j for i,j in marked)+1] for row in out[:max(i for i,j in marked)+1]]
    return out

from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    # The field color is most common; the second common color forms the grid lines.
    field = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    line_color = next((v for v, n in counts.most_common() if v != field), field)
    row_lines = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if sum(v == line_color for v in row) >= 0.65*w]
    col_lines = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == line_color for r in range(h)) >= 0.65*h]
    if len(row_lines) < 2 or len(col_lines) < 2:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    # Adjacent grid-line intersections bound one output cell.
    nr, nc = len(row_lines)-1, len(col_lines)-1
    out = [[field for _ in range(nc)] for _ in range(nr)]
    marked = []
    for i in range(nr):
        for j in range(nc):
            corners = [grid[row_lines[i]][col_lines[j]], grid[row_lines[i]][col_lines[j+1]],
                       grid[row_lines[i+1]][col_lines[j]], grid[row_lines[i+1]][col_lines[j+1]]]
            candidates = [v for v in corners if v != line_color and v != field]
            if candidates and len(set(candidates)) == 1:
                out[i][j] = candidates[0]
                marked.append((i,j))
    if marked:
        out = [row[:max(j for i,j in marked)+1] for row in out[:max(i for i,j in marked)+1]]
    return out
